name: Lisa Hubler
reason: Re-checked under the 12 Nov rule (amindmatters.com, 12 Nov 2026): Mind Matters Restorative Hypnotherapy in Toluca Lake, CA is a hypnotherapy practice whose sessions are sold by issue (weight management, eating and body image, stop smoking, anxiety, sleep, public speaking). Its Meditation (Vipassana-based) and Restorative Yoga pages describe parts of the hypnotherapy method delivered inside those sessions, not classes of their own; the trainings are 'on a temporary break'; what remains is a shop page of recordings (sleep, relaxation, yoga nidra, and also 'Speedy Bone Healing'). Hypnotherapy is out of scope as therapy, so too little spiritual or contemplative teaching of her own is left for a listing.
